description: Stops a session burning tokens on status checks that cannot learn anything. Denies a read of a pull request or commit whose state this session already watched settle, or that it already read with no user message, wake event or push since -- keyed on the subject, so re-asking through a different tool is still a repeat. Also refuses to end a turn that is the latest in a run of identical, closely-spaced turns
name: no-busy-poll
